articles.title: DigitalOcean Elevates its Agentic Inference Cloud with GPU Droplets powered by AMD Instinct™ MI350X GPUs
articles.mainIdea: DigitalOcean Elevates its Agentic Inference Cloud with GPU Droplets powered by AMD Instinct™ MI350X GPUs
articles.summary: Business Wire: DigitalOcean Elevates its Agentic Inference Cloud with GPU Droplets powered by AMD Instinct™ MI350X GPUs. BROOMFIELD, Colo., February 19, 2026--DigitalOcean (NYSE: DOCN), the Agentic Inference Cloud built for production AI at scale, today announced the availability of new, high-performance GPU Droplets powered by AMD Instinct™ MI350X GPUs. By integrating these GPUs into its Agentic Inference Cloud, DigitalOcean continues to deliver cost-efficient, high-performance solutions for leading AI-native companies like ACE Studio to scale their inference workloads.
